deep.reconstruction:
This page has no mathematics. It is a printed bookseller's form, an 'Interims-Nota' (provisional invoice or delivery note), from the Deuerlich'sche Buchhandlung in Göttingen. It is filled in by hand and addressed to 'Herr Professor Riemann Hochwohlgeboren'.

Of the three printed delivery options, 'als Fortsetzung' (as a continuation, i.e. a standing order for a serial) is the one that applies. 'zur geneigten Ansicht' (on approval) is clearly struck out. 'auf Bestellung' (on order) is either struck out or crossed by the underline of the flourish of 'Hochwohlgeboren'; the image is ambiguous.

The printed currency heading 'Sgr.' (Silbergroschen, the Prussian unit) has been overwritten by hand to 'Ggr.' (Gutegroschen, the Hanoverian unit). This fits Göttingen being in the Kingdom of Hanover in 1861.

The single item is '1. Accessionen der Universitätsbibliothek. 1860.', i.e. the annual printed accessions list of the Göttingen University Library for 1860. The price is 0 Rthlr. 15 Ggr. The form is dated 'Göttingen, den 24 Juli 1861'. A pencil folio number '31' appears at the upper right.

The document matters only biographically. It shows Riemann, then ordinary professor, holding a standing subscription to the library's accession lists in 1861. The facing pages, a draft lecture announcement for WS 1858/59 and a stray algebraic identity, are unrelated to this sheet.

There are no derivations to reconstruct.

results.what: Bookseller's invoice to Riemann for the 1860 accessions list of the Göttingen University Library, price 15 Gutegroschen, dated 24 July 1861

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a commercial delivery note for a library accessions list, with no mathematical content. It has minor biographical interest only (Riemann's subscription habits and Hanoverian currency in 1861).

checkable.asserts: Context only, from the PREVIOUS page (folio 30v), not this page. The denominator mu^4 - mu^4 eps^2 - 1 + mu^2 eps^2 factors as (mu^2-1)(mu^2+1-mu^2 eps^2). This is consistent with the right-hand side denominator written there. Nothing on folio 31r itself is checkable.

transcription_corrections: The machine transcription marks 'auf Bestellung' as struck through. In the image, the line under 'als Fortsetzung; auf Bestellung' may be the extended underline or flourish of 'Hochwohlgeboren' rather than a deletion. Only 'zur geneigten Ansicht' is unambiguously struck out.

Currency header: the printed 'Sgr.' is overwritten in ink to 'Ggr.' rather than being a separate deletion plus insertion. The item's price is 15 Ggr. in the second column, with nothing ('.') in the Rthlr. column.
A pencil folio number '31' at the upper right is not recorded in the transcription.
The year is printed '18' with '61' handwritten: '24 Juli 1861'.

Regarding the NEXT page: if it is truly mirror-image bleed-through of this sheet, its readings '1864' are almost certainly misreadings of the reversed '1861'. They should not be taken as a separate 1864 invoice.
